query: H3 audio/video VAE decode crashes (NestedTensor error in decode_tiled) on torch 2.9.1+cu128 (WSL and Windows); related triton 'Python.h not found' compile errors also seen.

desired.outcome: OP (C5): updating to torch 2.11.0+cu128 fixed it on Windows. cushycrux (C6) fixed the triton compile variant via woct0rdho/triton-windows #8 (embedded-python notes). hum-ma (C8): don't use the tiled node - H3 VAE has built-in tiling (see #15274).
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix directionally correct.
